method: micelio 1288a69 (1288a692) with this repository's themes/cartel at 0.1.1 (main 92aae16 plus the change of bogd3v/micelio-themes#30), built with MICELIO_SPECIMEN=1 and served against the mock Strapi, in Playwright 1.63.0 with its Chromium only (not Firefox or WebKit). An agent (Claude) ran every line but screen-reader.names and screen-reader.announcements under the maintainer's supervision, with the core's theme suite specs and Playwright probe scripts, not with a screen reader: 6 pages (home, blog, article, about, specimen, Spanish article) x papel/tinta x 1280/390 px x notice shown/dismissed = 48 runs and 4660 Tab stops, plus forced colors (28 runs), 200 % zoom, 320 px, WCAG 1.4.12 CSS and reduced motion by emulation. The images of the mock's CDN were replaced by a 1 px image. The two screen-reader lines were not run: the maintainer chose not to run them for this version.

keyboard.operable.note: 48 runs, 4660 Tab stops, the same walk as keyboard.focus-visible: every visible control is a Tab stop. This probe counted 4668 stops for 4668 visible controls, 2 more on each of the 4 specimen runs with the notice dismissed (270 and 254, the counts of the runs with the notice shown). Operated with the keyboard: the mode switch with Enter and Space (56 of 56), details (248 of 248), filter chips (48 of 48), text fields (96 of 96), and the newsletter's new consent checkbox with Space (24 of 24). The two Mermaid diagrams of the specimen are Tab stops once drawn (8 of 8 specimen runs). The slider is operated as in pointer.dragging.

keyboard.order.note: Still at 1288a69, the same in both modes at 1280 px: on home and the specimen the fediverse widget's instance field comes after 'Pick a server on joinmastodon.org' below it, and 'Copy code' after the newsletter's Subscribe; on About the code block comes before the 'search' link above it and 'Buy me a coffee' before 'LinkedIn'. WCAG 2.4.3. The core's starter theme on the same build has the same pairs, and Cartel has no positive tabindex and no control in its slots. The issue is closed and these pairs remain. Accepted as before: the blog sidebar after the list, and the footer read column by column.

keyboard.focus-visible.note: 4660 stops: 4616 change 20 pixels or more by 3:1 with and without focus. The fixed Back to top button now has its own ring (theme.css): 2 px solid ink with a 2 px offset, 15:1 against the page on papel and 14.9:1 on tinta, 346 to 368 changed pixels; before it was the colour of the button's fill (0). Under 20 in the probe: the specimen's card links, whose ring is a 2 px outline on the card (5968 to 10808 pixels when measured on the card), and the logo cloud's image links, which show a 1 px ring in the focus colour (7.5:1 on papel, 13.4:1 on tinta) that the probe could not count because the logo track moves.

keyboard.focus-not-hidden.note: 0 of 4660 stops hidden whole. Fewer than half of 15 sample points visible: the second topic card of the home guide at 390 px (3 of 15, 4 runs, in a horizontal scroller). focus-not-obscured.spec.ts and notice-room.spec.ts of the core pass for Cartel; the Back to top button folds away while the focus is elsewhere (core).

keyboard.skip-link.note: 48 of 48 runs: the first Tab stop is the skip link, Enter moves the focus into <main> and the next Tab lands inside it, notice shown and dismissed.

keyboard.overlays.note: 92 triggers (the search palette from the header and the tab bar, the menu sheet at 390 px) and 40 Ctrl+K: each opens with the keyboard with the focus inside, keeps it inside over 25 Tabs, closes with Escape and returns the focus to its trigger. The account menu was not opened (the mock has no signed-in user).

screen-reader.landmarks.note: 48 runs: one main, one banner, one contentinfo, and every nav has a name of its own. From the DOM and axe (no violation in the theme suite), not with a screen reader.

screen-reader.headings.note: 48 runs: one level-1 heading and no skipped level (on the specimen the copies inside its frames read as level 4; core-a11y.spec.ts passes). That the heading list reads as an outline was not judged by a person.

screen-reader.names.note: A person's line, not run: the maintainer chose not to run the screen-reader lines for this version (decision of 2026-11-27). Axe finds no control without a name in the theme suite.

screen-reader.announcements.note: A person's line, not run with a screen reader: the maintainer chose not to run the screen-reader lines for this version (decision of 2026-11-27).

screen-reader.language.note: html lang is en on every page and es on the Spanish article. At 1288a69 the references of the Spanish article whose language is set to English carry lang=en on their titles (bogd3v/micelio#788 is fixed there), and the language buttons carry lang. Cartel adds no text of its own outside its i18n files.

zoom.200.note: 640x400 at devicePixelRatio 2 (200 % of 1280), every page and mode, notice shown and dismissed (24 runs): scrollWidth equals clientWidth and nothing is past the edge outside a scroller.

zoom.reflow-320.note: reflow.spec.ts of the core passes for Cartel in both modes: no page scrolls horizontally at 320 px.

zoom.text-spacing.note: WCAG 1.4.12 CSS injected (line height 1.5, letter spacing 0.12 em, word spacing 0.16 em, paragraph margin 2 em) on all 48 runs: no new horizontal overflow, nothing past the edge outside a scroller and no newly clipped text. Automatic detection; overlapping text was not looked for by eye.

motion.reduced.note: The papel-reduced and tinta-reduced projects of the core's theme suite pass (22 tests).

motion.forced-colors.note: forcedColors: active in Chromium, 28 runs and 2536 Tab stops: every stop but the specimen's card links (whose ring is on the card, not measured by the probe) shows an indicator, the Back to top button included; pressed and unpressed switches and chips differ. Not verified: nothing was looked at on a real high-contrast system or in Firefox, and text legibility and information by colour alone were not judged by eye on every page.

pointer.target-size.note: Axe (wcag22aa, target-size): no violation in the theme suite. Own check of WCAG 2.5.8 over 2430 targets in 24 runs: the 434 smaller than 24x24 px all have no other target within 12 px of their centre. The new consent checkbox is 13 to 18 px with the nearest target 24.5 px away; slider buttons 44x44 px; slider dots 24x4 and 40x4 px, 20 and 28 px from the next target; table of contents links 38 px tall or more.

pointer.dragging.note: Spanish article with the slider (both modes, 1280 and 390 px, 4 of 4): the next and previous buttons move it with Enter and Space, the arrow keys move it, the dots are buttons and move it; nothing is draggable. Cartel adds nothing that is dragged or swiped.
